title: A Multi-Region Brain Model to Elucidate the Role of Hippocampus in Spatially Embedded Decision-Making

layout.note: Four lettered panels in a 2 x 2 grid without outer frames: A prior circuit top left, B proposed wiring top right, C joint and disjoint grid-code rows bottom left, D T-maze and RL loop bottom right.

lesson: Keep one colour per variable or region in both the circuit panel and the task-environment panel, and number the circuit's links to give the computation order. Show a toy trajectory on small state-space tiles to contrast two coding schemes.
